mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% (FEDFUNDS <= 2.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity present values, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 2.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points (UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months) signals tightening labor market conditions, supporting stronger corporate earnings and positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS > 500000) growth signals strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when HOUST>1200 and RSAFS>500000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates easing supply chain bottlenecks and accelerating manufacturing output, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when INDPRO>105.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 18700 billion (GDPC1 > 18700) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when GDPC1 > 18700.

mechanism_narrative: CPI exceeding 253.0 (CPIAUCSL > 253.0) indicates accelerating inflation, triggering Fed rate hike expectations and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 253.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS > 150000) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 3.9%) signals a tightening labor market, supporting stronger consumer spending and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when PAYEMS>150000 and UNRATE<3.9.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) compress equity valuations through rate hike expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5.
